{{Quote|I've been a scout for TaggeCo. for the better part of a decade and I've blazed trails on worlds stretching from Chandrila to Kal'Shebbol.|[[Bynder Zebb]], [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo.]] corporate scout|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
'''Kal'Shebbol''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Kal'Shebbol system/Legends|Kal'Shebbol system]], in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Kal'Shebbol was located on the [[Trition Trade Route]], the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected the major worlds of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] to the nearby [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. The planet was home to a colony during the [[third Galactic War]], but was also settled around [[392 BBY/Legends|392 BBY]] by escaped [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Kal'Shebbol grew from a small settlement into a major trading world only fifty years after the Twi'lek colonization as sizable [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Alien/Legends|alien]] communities emigrated to the planet in search of a fresh start. Once the Kathol sector entered the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Kal'Shebbol, being the closest planet to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]], was appointed as the sector [[Capital/Legends|capital]].

With the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kal'Shebbol fell under its auspices. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] was appointed as governor of the Kathol sector in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and made Kal'Shebbol his capital. His edicts were oppressive, and the people of Kal'Shebbol suffered under his rule as industry was nationalized and travel to and from the planet was severely restricted. With the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and the subsequent breakdown of Imperial authority, Sarne withdrew his sector from the Empire, setting up his own personal fiefdom with Kal'Shebbol as its capital.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|task force]] was sent to [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberate]] Kal'Shebbol from Sarne's control. Elements of [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]]&mdash;the New Republic's elite commando team&mdash;infiltrated the planet with the intention of dropping Kal'Shebbol's [[Deflector shield/Legends|defensive shield]] and capturing Sarne. While the commandos succeeded in lowering the shield, allowing New Republic forces to capture the planet, Sarne managed to escape into the Kathol sector with the majority of his [[Moff Sarne's forces|military forces]]. The New Republic established a new administration to run the planet, appointing an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] named [[Monjai]] as governor to appease the large alien communities residing on the world.

==Description==
[[File:Tritiontraderoute.jpg|thumb|left|A map of the Trition Trade Route, and Kal'Shebbol's placement on it]]
Kal'Shebbol was located in the [[Kal'Shebbol system/Legends|Kal'Shebbol system]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]<ref name="TDC" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It served as the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and was situated on the [[Trition Trade Route]], the primary [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] serving the sector.<ref name="TDC" /> The Trition Trade Route was a continuation of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], a major commercial hyperlane that connected the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to the Outer Rim;<ref name="Lords">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> despite being on the Trition, Kal'Shebbol was, on occasion, also considered to be a stopping point on the Rimma Trade Route.<ref name="Core">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Kal'Shebbol was connected to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Brolsam]] and [[Torize]] via a single hyperlane that branched off in two directions, as well as [[Pergitor]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].<ref name="TDC" /> It took just over nine [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to reach Pergitor when traveling from Kal'Shebbol,<ref name="Travel">Based on the fact that, in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', the travel [[Time/Legends|time]] between Kal'Shebbol and [[Karideph]] is 10 [[Standard day|days]]. As the travel time between Karideph and [[Pergitor]] is established as 20 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] in ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', subtracting this time from the 10 days figure gives us a time of 9 days, 4 hours for travel between Kal'Shebbol and Pergitor.</ref> eighteen [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to reach Torize, and a day and six hours to reach Brolsam with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Class 1 hyperdrive]].<ref name="TDC" />

Kal'Shebbol boasted a single continent, upon which the planet's population resided. Covered in wide, open plains and rolling hills, the planet was habitable with a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Wet weather patterns, coupled with arable land, made the continent suitable for [[Farm/Legends|farming]], which the planet's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] settlers took advantage of. The continent's terrain was also suitable for the grazing of herd animals, such as the native [[chollas]].<ref name="TDC" />

==History==
===Targeted by the Hidden Chain===
{{Quote|Based on intelligence provided by Mandalore, I was able to narrow my search and scout potential suppliers to Heta Kol and her group, the Hidden Chain. Heta's targets: Outer Rim colonies and transports on the Rimma Trade Route point to powerful trade houses shutting down their competition with her guns.|Akaavi Spar briefs the Alliance Commander|<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} mentions that the [[Dantooine Incursion]] and the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' took place in [[3627 BBY]].</ref>}}
[[File:KalShebbol_Onslaught.png|thumb|right|Akaavi Spar briefs the Alliance Commander on the situation along the Rimma Trade Route.]]
By [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> a colony had been established on the planet Kal'Shebbol. During the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], Kal'Shebbol&mdash;along with other colonies and [[Transport/Legends|transports]] along the Rimma Trade Route&mdash;was targeted by the disenfranchised [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Heta Kol]] and her forces known as the [[Hidden Chain]]. The Hidden Chain was prosecuting a series of assaults against the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|forces]] of the Mandalorian leader, [[Mandalore the Avenger]], and her allies, the military organization known as the[[Eternal Alliance]]. The Alliance launched an investigation into Kol's campaign, dispatching Mandalorian warrior [[Akaavi Spar]] to find out who was supplying the Hidden Chain with weapons.<ref name="Onslaught" />

Returning to [[Odessen]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of the Eternal Alliance, to report her findings, Spar briefed the [[Alliance Commander|leader]] of the Alliance directly. Spar concluded that Kol's targets pointed towards powerful trade houses shutting down their competition, and using Kol and the Hidden Chain to do it. As such, those organizations were Spar's mostly likely candidates to be supplying the Hidden Chain.<ref name="Onslaught" />

===Joining the galactic community===
Around [[392 BBY/Legends|392 BBY]],<ref name="Settling Date" /> Kal'Shebbol was settled by Twi'lek [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] who had escaped from their own [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Located on a trade route that led to [[Gandle Ott]], the first world to be settled in the Kathol sector, Kal'Shebbol was also isolated enough from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to allow the Twi'lek clans to live in peace. Although they initially found the open plains and moist atmosphere to be discomforting&mdash;as they were used to the arid conditions and caverns of Ryloth&mdash;they adapted quickly, domesticating the native herds of chollas and establishing farms to support their growing society.<ref name="TDC" />

Over the next fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]], many families traveled to Kal'Shebbol, intending to settle on the planet and start new lives. However, before they were allowed to take up residence on the world, they had to be formally adopted by one of the Twi'lek clans. Kal'Shebbol soon boasted a population of several million and had transformed from a simple layover point on the way to Gandle Ott to a major trading post.<ref name="TDC" />

When the Kathol sector was formally inducted into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Kal'Shebbol was appointed as the sector capital over Gandle Ott. Gandle Ott, located in the [[Ott system]] at the end of the Trition Trade Route, had been settled 200 years before Kal'Shebbol and was recognized as the first official colony in the sector. However, Kal'Shebbol was selected as the capital simply because it was closer to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] than Gandle Ott. By this point, Kal'Shebbol was ruled by a combination of clan and [[City/Legends|city]]-state governments.<ref name="TDC" />

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|Sarne wasn't exactly beloved by his public.|Jessa Dajus, to Lieutenant Judder Page|<ref name="TSB" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Declaration of a New Order|reformed]] the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Imperial [[Prefect/Legends|Prefects]] were assigned to run the planet, and they had little regard for the traditional way the planet had been run for centuries. The clan and city-state governments were made subservient to the will of those officials who had no desire to maintain the society's status quo.<ref name="TDC" />

[[File:Sarneheadshot.jpg|thumb|left|Moff Kentor Sarne, ruler of the Kathol sector and later Imperial warlord.]]
[[Kentor Sarne]] was appointed [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Kathol sector in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Appointment Date" /> As the capital of the sector, Kal'Shebbol became his personal stronghold and suffered under Sarne's oppressive edicts as private industry was nationalized and free travel to and from the planet was prohibited.<ref name="TDC" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine was [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Following his death, the Imperial command structure fragmented, with many senior officials breaking away from the Empire and forming their own [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] empires. Sarne followed suit, quietly withdrawing the Kathol sector from Imperial authorities. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] anyone realized what Sarne had done, it was too late to stop him, as they could not spare any forces to bring the rogue Moff back in line. Kal'Shebbol became the capital of Sarne's new empire.<ref name="TSB" />

In the ten years that Sarne ruled the planet&mdash;both as an official of the Empire and on his own&mdash;he turned the planet's one continent into a virtual fortress, protected by an [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]] and armed with anti-[[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], as well as anti-assault weapons on the shoreline. The [[Imperial Government Complex]] served as Sarne's military and governmental headquarters, and well as his private residence, which was known as "Sarne's Palace." The building contained the controls for the energy shield and weapons, the main command center so that Sarne could direct the defense of the planet, the Moff's personal quarters, and a secret [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] containing a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]], the ''[[Ambition]]'', Sarne's emergency escape vehicle.<ref name="TSB" />

During Sarne's reign, at least one [[Kal'Shebbol resistance group|resistance group]] opposed him, operating out of hidden rooms beneath [[Kal'Shebbol starport]]. The members of the group were gradually killed off in a series of skirmishes with Sarne's forces, with the only survivor being [[Genna Seedar]], who acted as the group's [[Medic/Legends|medic]].<ref name="TDC" /> In addition, Sarne ordered several [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] acts to be carried out on Kal'Shebbol&mdash;he would then blame the atrocities on Rebel insurgents as a way to turn public opinion against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and their successor state, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. One such attack claimed the lives of the family of [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Shella Inion]], a minor [[Actor/Legends|actress]] who would eventually become the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] Mist.<ref name="KO">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dating">In ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', [[Staven]] left comments on the [[DZ 17X Nemesis]] [[Power armor/Legends|powersuit's]] entry in [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] dated 39:2:3:83. As explained [[:Template:YearMathGRS|here]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' established that there is a two-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] difference between the start of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and the start of the [[Great ReSynchronization]] year. Therefore, the Galactic Standard Calendar year commences in the third month of the Great ReSynchronization year. The Great ReSynchronization was instituted in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], resulting in a difference of 35 years and 2 months between the two systems. A date of 39:2:3:83 therefore correlates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] via simple math.</ref> a subscriber to [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] named [[Staven]] commented on the entry for the [[DZ 17X Nemesis]] [[Power armor/Legends|powersuit]]. He said that while he believed all of the originally-produced Nemesis suits were gone, there was a rumor that ex-Imperial scientists were producing a suit with similar capabilities out near Kal'Shebbol.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

===New Republic===
{{Quote|I don't think Kal'Shebbol's new owners would approve of civilians carrying weapons through the streets.|Jessa Dajus, to [[Gorak Khzam]]|<ref name="TSB" />}}
[[File:BattleOfKalShebbol-TheDarkStryderCampaign.jpg|thumb|right|Page's Commandos infiltrate Kal'Shebbol during the New Republic's attack on the world.]]
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="DateExplanation" /> the New Republic received intelligence that suggested Sarne had access to a [[DarkStryder technology|potent new form of technology]]. In an effort to oust him from power and deny him the opportunity to use the technology, the New Republic assembled a [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|task force]] to liberate the planet. As the task force [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|engaged]] [[Moff Sarne's forces|Sarne's forces]] in orbit, elements of [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]]&mdash;who had been inserted on the planet posing as civilian traffic in a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]]&mdash;infiltrated Sarne's headquarters and deactivated the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting the sole continent. This allowed New Republic forces to successfully liberate Kal'Shebbol, although Sarne managed to escape in the ''Ambition'' before he could be apprehended by the Commandos. Sarne marshaled his forces in orbit and withdrew from the battle.<ref name="TSB" />

Despite the majority of Sarne's forces fleeing, the New Republic claimed victory at Kal'Shebbol. The inhabitants rejoiced at the overthrow of Moff Sarne and welcomed the New Republic, who established a provisional government headed by the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Monjai]]. Their main goal was to foster good will among the populace, and the selection of a non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] governor was considered a good start due to the large communities of alien [[Species/Legends|species]] that resided on the planet. While the New Republic expected to deploy a defense [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to Kal'Shebbol, it was not due to arrive for two to three months after its liberation. Monjai was forced to cobble together a rudimentary defense force from [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that were not destroyed during the New Republic's assault on the planet.<ref name="TDC" />

[[File:Ambition_blasts_off.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Page's Commandos attempt to stop Moff Sarne fleeing Kal'Shebbol in the ''Ambition''.]]
Sarne's escape was a worry to the New Republic, however, especially to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], commanding officer of Page's Commandos. He had seen Sarne's new weapons in action during the Moff's escape from the planet and knew that Sarne had to be hunted down before he had a chance to use them on a larger scale. Unfortunately for him, the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in charge of the task force did not believe the rumors and could not spare any ships to conduct a sweep of the Kathol sector. Page was forced to make use of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[FarStar|''Renegade'']], a vessel under Sarne's control that had been undergoing a refit at a secret [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located in the [[Sorbiss Valley]]. The location of the ship had been revealed to Page by [[Jessa Dajus]], a former [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] officer in Sarne's regime who wanted to track the Moff down for her own reasons. Due to manpower limitations within the task force, Page was forced to cobble together a crew of New Republic personnel and civilians from Kal'Shebbol to man the vessel, under the command of [[Keleman Ciro]], a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in Page's Commandos who was given a field promotion to [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. The makeshift crew prepared the vessel, now renamed as the ''FarStar'', and launched from Kal'Shebbol just after the New Republic task force had departed for the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]].<ref name="TSB" />

Several months after the liberation of Kal'Shebbol, the New Republic had deployed [[Warship/Legends|warships]] to assist in the defense of the planet.<ref name="KR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref> Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]]<ref name="time">Based on the amount of [[Time/Legends|time]] it would take the ''[[FarStar]]'' to traverse its known route&mdash;as shown by the travel times indicated on the maps of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]], and [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]&mdash;several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] would have passed between its launch and its encounter with [[Moff Sarne's forces]] at [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]].</ref> after the ''FarStar'' departed on its mission, a message relayed through the [[Lifeline Project]]&mdash;<ref name="E">''[[Endgame]]''</ref> a series of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] stationed within the hazardous area known as the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] to maintain communication between the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] and the New Republic authorities on Kal'Shebbol&mdash;<ref name="KR" />informed Governor Monjai that the ship had located Sarne at the planet [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Monjai immediately dispatched a force to the area, although it would take [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] to arrive. Several weeks later, the force returned to Kal'Shebbol with the crew of the ''FarStar'', who had successfully stopped Sarne during a [[Battle of Kathol System|climatic battle]] at Kathol. Despite suffering the loss of their ship and numerous casualties, the survivors of the ''FarStar'' were greeted enthusiastically by Monjai.<ref name="E" />

==Inhabitants==
Originally colonized by escaped Twi'lek slaves, Kal'Shebbol was rapidly inhabited by many other species fifty years after its initial settling. While Humans were abundant on the planet, Kal'Shebbol had sizable alien communities. They suffered under the [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]] rule of the Galactic Empire, until the planet's liberation by the New Republic in 8 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. At this point, the New Republic appointed Monjai, an Elomin, to run the planet as governor. Her appointment appeased the large alien communities that were distrustful of Humans in general.<ref name="TDC" /> Individuals from Kal'Shebbol included [[Solla Deremot]], a research assistant who assisted Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|science]] team [[MS-133]]'s archaeological expedition on [[Aaris III]];<ref name="AOA">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Artifact of Aaris|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> Shella Inion, a minor actress who became the bounty hunter known as Mist;<ref name="KO" /> and [[Cal Alder/Legends|Cal Alder]], a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who served in both the Rebel Alliance and the New Republic.<ref name="Hoth-Alder">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Cal Alder}}</ref>

==Locations==
The Imperial Government Complex&mdash;also known locally as "Sarne's Palace"&mdash;was the center of Imperial authority on Kal'Shebbol. Surrounded by a [[death fence]] and protected by [[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar]] [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Towers]], the complex was a mixture of squat military bunkers and administrative spires. The complex contained Sarne's private quarters, the command and control for the planetary defenses, research labs, detention cells, a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] arena, and a secret hangar containing the ''Carrack''-class [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] ''Ambition''.<ref name="TSB" /> Following the fall of the planet to New Republic forces in 8 ABY, the complex became the headquarters of the newly established administration under Governor Monjai.<ref name="TDC" />

[[File:FarStar.jpg|thumb|right|The CR90 corvette ''FarStar'', modified at the Sorbiss Valley dock]]
The Sorbiss Valley was the location of a secret shipyard created during Moff Sarne's reign as ruler of the planet. Large enough to berth a single CR90 corvette, the shipyard was responsible for refitting the corvette ''Renegade'' from a standard vessel into one capable of extended operations away from a home port for an indefinite period of time. One of the major modifications was the addition of a hangar deck bolted onto the starboard side of the vessel. In 8 ABY, Sarne was forced to leave the ''Renegade'' behind during his flight from the capital, and its location was discovered by the New Republic, who took the vessel, rechristening it as the ''FarStar'', and tasked it with trailing Sarne as he fled into the Kathol sector.<ref name="TSB" />

[[File:FarStar_loading.jpg|thumb|left|The ''FarStar'' is loaded at the spaceport prior to launching on his mission to track down Moff Sarne.]]
Kal'Shebbol starport was the planet's primary transportation hub for individuals either arriving at or leaving Kal'Shebbol. By 8 ABY, Sarne had instituted high tariffs at the starport, meaning that many independent [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and visitors to the planet often found themselves stranded when they could not afford the high docking bay fees and had their ships impounded. Facilities at the starport included at least one [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], a [[Loh'khar's shop|trading post]] run by Twi'lek merchant [[Loh'khar]] the Finder, and a [[Brophar Tofarain's repair yard|repair yard]] maintained by [[Brophar Tofarain]]. Shortly before the New Republic's liberation of the planet, the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Unda Lagor]] went on a rampage through one of the starport's busiest quarters, killing forty-three civilians and twenty-one Imperial troops.<ref name="TDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kal'Shebbol was created for ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', a [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. It was the first book in the [[The DarkStryder Campaign (series)|series of the same name]]. The sourcebook detailed the planet of Kal'Shebbol,<ref name="TDC" /> with the short story "[[The Saga Begins]]" by [[Timothy Zahn]] using the world as its primary setting.<ref name="TSB" /> The planet was mentioned throughout the sourcebook in relation to characters' backstories, as well as receiving an entry in the "Kathol Sector Overview" section.<ref name="TDC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the planet in grid square M-21.<ref name="Atlas" /> ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] supplement to [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] series, misspells the world as "Kal'sebbol."<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

Gandle Ott was explicitly stated to be the first world settled in the Kathol sector in ''The DarkStryder Campaign'', which stated that this occurred some six [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the book's setting four years after the Battle of Endor.<ref name="TDC" /> However, this was contradicted by the [[2019]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which states that Kal'Shebbol is home to a colony as early as 3627 BBY, and therefore was settled several thousand years prior to Gandle Ott.<ref name="Onslaught" />

Kal'Shebbol's appearance in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught'' is via a hologram display listing planets on the Rimma Trade Route in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. The hologram only appears in the expansion if Akaavi Spar delivers the briefing on the Hidden Chain to the Alliance Commander, regardless of the player being aligned to the Galactic Republic or [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. If the player does not send Spar to investigate the Hidden Chain's activities, then [[Hylo Visz]] will deliver the information; however, the holographic map and the mention of Kal'Shebbol will not appear during the briefing.<ref name="Onslaught" />
